tool_args.rationale: Fit the three identifiable coefficients of the recalled open-branch law numerically and seek fresh confirmation. Its supercritical behavior remains unidentified by the available observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition and Cobb-Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open-branch observations provide gradient variation supporting the recalled saturating sink mechanism; confirmation can test its extrapolation.
All observed gradients are below the stated critical range, so its coefficient and threshold cannot be fitted from these rows; the recommended high-gradient probe is not in the available menu.
The current ambiguity concerns the unobserved high-gradient branch rather than trajectory resolution, so this probe is not clearly discriminating.
The nuisance measurement is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
